_about: Hard Ask retrieval set (50 cases: paraphrase, Hinglish, long client email, conflict, brand, missing, multi-hop). Questions written for LegalMind; every gold ref is a CURRENT record (Constitution L1.14, published policies, live statutes, ratified positions) whose text states the answer. A case is a list of gold SLOTS; a slot is met by any of its refs (fnmatch; a ref also matches its own sub-sections, e.g. CONST:9 meets CONST:9.2). Empty gold = nothing in our sources answers it. must_not = the other brand's policy. Labels approved by the owner 2026-10-26. Scored by tools/hard_benchmark.py, zero Gemini.

Disaster recovery - LeapSwitch to confirm: (a) that DR is added to the Service Scope; (b) a committed RPO of 1 hour and RTO of 4 hours; (c) DR invocation on failure, cyber incident or the client's request, with failback without data loss; (d) DR drills twice a year, with a written report.

Security - LeapSwitch to confirm encryption at rest and in transit, MFA for admin access, access logs retained in India for 180 days, incident notification within 6 hours and a root cause analysis within 5 business days.

Service levels - LeapSwitch to: (a) share the SLA, including how uptime is measured and the service credits; (b) confirm planned maintenance only outside business hours, with prior notice; (c) confirm response and resolution times; (d) confirm that availability below the SLA in 2 consecutive months allows termination without charges.

Pricing and payment - LeapSwitch to confirm: (a) prices fixed for the 12-month term; (b) only undisputed invoices payable, disputes within 10 working days; (c) prepaid fees refunded pro rata on our breach or force majeure.
Early termination - allow termination with 30-60 day written notice, or cap early-termination liability.
Data retention & ownership - minimum 60-day retention after termination with full data export; customer data and backups remain customer property.
Suspension for non-payment - formal grace period and notification before suspension.
Payment terms - we are MSME registered, request a 45-day payment cycle.
